WITH Sume AS
(
    SELECT 'BCR' AS CodBanca, Marca, Suma, Luna, Anul, CodSucursala, TipPlata, DataPlatii, DenumireFisier
    FROM app.SumaBCR
    WHERE Status = 2

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'BRD', Marca, Suma, Luna, Anul, CodSucursala, TipPlata, DataPlatii, DenumireFisier
    FROM app.SumaBRD
    WHERE Status = 2

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'BT', Marca, Suma, Luna, Anul, CodSucursala, TipPlata, DataPlatii, DenumireFisier
    FROM app.SumaBT
    WHERE Status = 2

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'CEC', Marca, Suma, Luna, Anul, CodSucursala, TipPlata, DataPlatii, DenumireFisier
    FROM app.SumaCEC
    WHERE Status = 2

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'ING', Marca, Suma, Luna, Anul, CodSucursala, TipPlata, DataPlatii, DenumireFisier
    FROM app.SumaING
    WHERE Status = 2

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'MIL', Marca, Suma, Luna, Anul, CodSucursala, TipPlata, DataPlatii, DenumireFisier
    FROM app.SumaEXM
    WHERE Status = 2

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'RZB', Marca, Suma, Luna, Anul, CodSucursala, TipPlata, DataPlatii, DenumireFisier
    FROM app.SumaRZB
    WHERE Status = 2

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'UNI', Marca, Suma, Luna, Anul, CodSucursala, TipPlata, DataPlatii, DenumireFisier
    FROM app.SumaUNI
    WHERE Status = 2

    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'ALTE', Marca, Suma, Luna, Anul, CodSucursala, TipPlata, DataPlatii, DenumireFisier
    FROM app.SumaALTE
    WHERE Status = 2
)

INSERT INTO app.BancaFisierTransfer
(
    IdCentr,
    CodSucursala,
    Anul,
    Luna,
    CodBanca,
    DenumireBanca,
    EmailDestinatar,
    MesajTransmitere,
    DataPlatii,
    TipPlata,
    DenumireFisier,
    NumarSalariati,
    ValoareTotala,
    Status,
    CreatedDate
)
SELECT
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER
    (
        ORDER BY
            CAST(s.DataPlatii AS DATE),
            bc.CodBanca,
            s.TipPlata
    ),
    s.CodSucursala,
    s.Anul,
    s.Luna,
    bc.CodBanca,
    bc.DenumireBanca,
    bc.EmailCNPR,
    '',
    CAST(s.DataPlatii AS DATE),
    s.TipPlata,
    s.DenumireFisier,
    COUNT(*),
    SUM(ISNULL(s.Suma, 0)),
    1,
    GETDATE()
FROM Sume s
INNER JOIN app.BancaCard bc
    ON bc.CodBanca = s.CodBanca
WHERE s.CodSucursala = @CodSucursala
  AND s.Luna = @Luna
  AND s.Anul = @Anul
  AND NOT EXISTS
  (
      SELECT 1
      FROM app.BancaFisierTransfer bft
      WHERE bft.CodSucursala = s.CodSucursala
        AND bft.Anul = s.Anul
        AND bft.Luna = s.Luna
        AND bft.CodBanca = bc.CodBanca
        AND bft.TipPlata = s.TipPlata
        AND CAST(bft.DataPlatii AS DATE) = CAST(s.DataPlatii AS DATE)
  )
GROUP BY
    s.CodSucursala,
    s.Anul,
    s.Luna,
    bc.CodBanca,
    bc.DenumireBanca,
    bc.EmailCNPR,
    s.DenumireFisier,
    CAST(s.DataPlatii AS DATE),
    s.TipPlata;
